steps.headline: Same cowboy, three bodies that aren't gold. The wine hat with its gold band is unchanged on all three.

variants.label: A — Bone
variants.summary: A pale sun-bleached cream, like weathered bone or bleached canvas. The brightest of the three against this near-black theme, so he is the easiest to find on a dark wallpaper, and the hat's wine red reads loudest against him. Closest in feel to the gold you didn't want, without being the accent colour.

variants.label: B — Sandstone
variants.summary: A warm terracotta taken straight from the mesa in this theme's wallpaper. The most desert of the three and the most obviously a character rather than a swatch. Sits mid-way in brightness, so he neither glows nor disappears.

variants.label: C — Plum
variants.summary: A dark plum body with a gold-outlined face, the same trick that rescued Halftone. He belongs to the theme more completely than the other two — but he is quiet, and on a busy dark wallpaper you will notice him last.

steps.risk: C's face is drawn in gold line rather than a solid dark shape, so it reads as lit; A and B keep the ordinary painted face.

steps.headline: The Stargazer's star moved up, so he holds it beside his head instead of down by his fist.
steps.changed: The star and its stick both rise about a unit and a quarter. Nothing else about him changed.
steps.notice: He reads as holding the star up rather than carrying it. The star now sits at head height, where your eye is already looking.
steps.risk: It sits closer to the edge of his frame, so on the narrowest surfaces the star's right point is the first thing to get tight.
